visualCharacteristics.purpose: side-by-side groups of resource links, each topped by a CTA link and a titled heading
visualCharacteristics.description: White band. H2 'Start Designing Today with NXP' (hidden under the sticky header in the stitched screenshot). Two fixed columns of link lists (1/3 + 2/3, the second split into two link columns), each topped by a blue chevron CTA link and a bordered H3. Below: beige banner box, text left (~40%) with H3, text with inline link and orange pill CTA, photo right.

contentPattern.structure: one row; each cell = CTA link paragraph, H3 heading, bulleted list of links. Lists with more than 6 links render in two columns; with two cells the layout is 1/3 + 2/3
contentPattern.description: Fixed set of two different link groups side by side that does not wrap into a grid of look-alike items.

usage: Resource/finder link groups such as "Product Finders" and "Design Resources".
reuseGuidance: Any fixed set of 2-3 link lists side by side.
